consumerCopy.requirement: Byte-identical copy of every populated set, compared by make protocol-compat.

sets.name: auth
sets.purpose: Client certificate profile, RFC 9440 header profile, authentication and credential-rotation proof vectors, surface separation, and the frozen error reason registry.

sets.name: version
sets.purpose: Protocol version negotiation decisions, the frozen v1 negotiation field registry, and additive compatibility in both skew directions.

sets.name: registration
sets.purpose: Registration token exchange, proof of possession, replay rejection, and certificate issuance.

sets.name: heartbeat
sets.purpose: Heartbeat payloads, Connect receive time, and freshness window behavior.

sets.name: inventory
sets.purpose: Inventory snapshot payloads and their allow-listed collection fields.

sets.name: object-performance
sets.purpose: Bounded performance.object@1 result acceptance and rejection vectors.

sets.name: network-performance
sets.purpose: Bounded performance.network@1 aggregate results, peer attribution, unit semantics, and budget rejection vectors.

sets.name: site-replication-performance
sets.purpose: Bounded performance.siteReplication@1 aggregate results, destination-confirmation semantics, and rejection of operational secrets and unresolved target controls.

sets.name: telemetry
sets.purpose: Consent-bound telemetry.record@1, telemetry.otlp@1, and telemetry.replay@1 producer results, resource limits, redaction boundaries, cancellation, and signed local exports.

sets.name: diagnostic-scheduler
sets.purpose: Consent-bound diagnostic policy scheduling, bounded retry, cancellation, restart deduplication, and outbound Connect-visible execution receipts.

sets.name: offline-enrollment
sets.purpose: Air-gapped device enrolment and signed artifact exchange without a certificate.

sets.name: bundle
sets.purpose: Support bundle manifests, upload authorization, archive validation, and signed typed offline diagnostic imports.

sets.name: redaction
sets.purpose: Deterministic redaction of telemetry and support bundle content.
